iconicAnchor.label: Standardized identification plates, manuals, and machine markings
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Industrial documentation and government technical graphic standards
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The active United States military property-marking standard establishes the operational tradition of durable free-text and machine-readable identification applied directly to equipment.

sources.title: MIL-STD-130: Identification Marking of U.S. Military Property
supports: Industrial identification systems use standardized marking criteria for durable free-text and machine-readable information.
The standard supports the guide's use of machine plates, codes, serial logic, and direct equipment labeling.

sources.title: NASA Graphics Standards Manual
supports: The manual documents restrained grids, bold headings, flush-left setting, and controlled black-and-white or two-color reproduction.
Its production guidance supports monochrome technical graphics that prioritize identification and image clarity.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set.
